q0AnchorReason: q0_anchor was declared False ('no q0-dependent field'). Untrue: the characters are evaluated as chi = sum c_e * q0**e, so every published number is a function of q0. Stamped `ambiguous` rather than `proton` because this quantity STRADDLES layers: chi and the canonical tr_M target (canonical-tr-m-via-chi-cache.witness.json) are at the proton pin, while the Wenzl weights y_lambda come from wenzl-y-lambda-h12.witness.json, whose data.q0 is the CODATA-2018 MUON derivation 1.109978595554180575281594... The pin actually used for chi is in parameters.q0 below. Closing the straddle needs wenzl-y-lambda-h12 re-pinned, which has ten in-repo consumers (bean qou-9ugp).
